notes: Section classifier (extract-sections.js) mislabeled two home-page sections by heading mismatch: 'pricing-table' (order 2, heading 'So they submitted. Now what?') was corrected to 'dashboard-preview'; 'logo-wall' (order 5, heading 'Why does this beat contact forms...') was corrected to 'comparison-table'. Both corrections verified against section screenshots before finalizing the catalog.

The classifier did not surface any candidate at all for the /pricing pricing-cards block or the /directory grid+filter block — root cause: both pages nest their content in `body > main > main > div` / `body > main > div > div > div` (a double wrapper, not a `<section>` the classifier's DOM walk expects). Both selectors were hand-located via direct DOM query and verified with a screenshot before distillation.
